description: This Java source file defines an abstract class ConnectivitySignalEnrichmentProvider that provides a mechanism to load and retrieve SignalEnrichmentFacade instances based on connection IDs, using Akka actor system extensions. It includes methods for dynamic loading based on configuration and references external classes related to connectivity, signal enrichment, and Akka actor system extensions.

classes.name: ConnectivitySignalEnrichmentProvider
classes.description: An abstract class that provides methods to retrieve signal enrichment facades based on connection IDs and to load provider instances dynamically using Akka extensions.

classes.name: ExtensionId
classes.description: A private static inner class extending AbstractExtensionId to manage the creation of ConnectivitySignalEnrichmentProvider extensions based on actor system configuration.

methods.name: getFacade
methods.description: Abstract method to create a SignalEnrichmentFacade from a given ConnectionId.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the ConnectivitySignalEnrichmentProvider extension for a given ActorSystem.

methods.name: createExtension
methods.description: Creates an extension of ConnectivitySignalEnrichmentProvider based on the actor system and configuration.
